title: A foundation model enhanced approach for generative design in combinational creativity
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper proposes an AI foundation model enhanced approach for generative design in combinational creativity. It involves using large language models (LLMs) and text-to-image (T2I) models to generate and visualize combinational ideas. The study evaluates the effectiveness of this approach through experiments with novice designers.
